note: CORE-569: painted content-free declared-height boxes fragment at a page break (under an auto-height parent); contain:size boxes stay monolithic; a fresh table row whose cells hold only such boxes splits instead of deferring whole (unless break-inside: avoid). Full WPT status run: base 232 PASS / 77 FAIL, candidate 234 PASS / 75 FAIL. Flips: table-fragmentation-002c and -002d FAIL -> PASS; zero PASS -> FAIL. Each document below was checked per page against the harness Chromium leg (5x3in, 0.5in margins) by colour-band extents. The change ids are identical to the ones examined at candidate 3208578, so the examined output is unchanged. Out-of-gate A/B (328 css-break/css-page/css-multicol reftests using contain:size|strict or tables, 411 docs): 56 changed; 34 less red, 11 same, 11 more red. All 11 more-red docs already show red at base. 10 are contain:size screen tests: the size-contained boxes stay whole now (css-contain-2 3.2), where the base split them. 1 is border-collapse-001 (+22 px). The two out-of-gate regressions found during this work (section-with-overflow-001: red 0 -> 1924; table-border-006) were fixed and have regression tests.
